citations.quote: In this reading, we identify and discuss two types of government policy that can affect the macroeconomy and financial markets: monetary policy and fiscal policy.
This is the process whereby a central bank’s interest rate gets transmitted through the economy and ultimately affects the rate of increase of prices

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: CFA L1 R12 frames monetary policy as central-bank influence on money/credit operating through interest-rate, asset-price, exchange-rate, expectations channels, and fiscal policy as government taxation/spending; together they regulate AD with monetary policy faster (no legislative lag), fiscal slower but sector-targetable, subject to ZLB / crowding-out / time-inconsistency limits.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Monetary and Fiscal Policy Mechanics (CFA L1 R12)
